Marvelous Light

Lucy and Leo discover the fruits of the Spirit in a magical world of talking animals and hidden biblical truths.

Watch a free previewAll shows
Lucy & Leo’s Bible adventures

About the series

Two kids, a lantern and a world where every animal has a story to tell. Across two seasons, Lucy and Leo step into the biggest stories of the Bible and come home with something to practice at the dinner table: gentleness, courage, faithfulness, joy.

Ad-freeAges 4–824 episodes
Why families love it

Made to be watched together

  • Each episode follows one Bible story from beginning to end, so kids meet the real people of Scripture, not just the moral.
  • Episodes are paced for short attention spans and end with a takeaway a 5-year-old can repeat back to you.
  • Voiced by an African American cast across the whole series, so our kids see and hear themselves in God’s story.
